name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.0 degrees south of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 31 times in 14 visits over 59 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 64 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.5 days starting 2026-04-30, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
